description: Creates an unsent draft on the inbox. Omit `thread_id` and `reply_to_email_id` for a draft that starts a new thread. Pass both together for a reply draft in an existing thread. A reply draft without `to` is addressed to the sender of the email it replies to, or to its Reply-To when set. For an email the inbox sent, it defaults to that email's `to` recipients. Send `to: []` to leave it empty. At least one of `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `subject`, `text`, `html` or `attachments` must be non-empty. The combined recipients of `to`, `cc` and `bcc` cannot exceed 50. Attachments are stored on the draft, so a `path` file is downloaded when the request is made. Returns 201 for a new draft. Only one unsent reply draft can target an email, so a reply draft request for an email that already has one returns 200 with the ID of the existing draft. An unknown `thread_id`, or a `reply_to_email_id` that is not in that thread, returns a 404. That request ignores every other field, except `attachments`, which replaces the attachments of the existing draft when sent. A reply draft created without `subject` stores an empty subject. When it is sent, it takes the thread subject, prefixed with `Re:` when it does not already start with it.
